notes: All four generating points and three true noise laws; joint cold records, sigma=0.25 C. IID known/fitted variance, Bartlett HAC bandwidths 10/30/60 samples, and IID profiles known/fitted variance. Coverage is conditional on a defined interval; bars are pointwise 95% Wilson Monte Carlo intervals. Dashed line is nominal 0.95. Hollow markers flag fewer than 300 defined intervals; NA is undefined, never zero coverage. Widths are medians among defined intervals; disconnected profile widths sum component lengths, not their envelope. Exact counts, unconditional failure bounds, exploration flags and interpolation sensitivity remain in coverage_delay_data.json/CSV. No simultaneous, universal or real-model-discrepancy coverage claim.
